title: [submission] Garnet - self-hosted Polymarket copy-trading engine in Rust
body:
### Link

https://github.com/AndreySchurko/garnet-polymarket

### What is it

Tool - a bot, screener, dashboard or execution layer

### Which venues does it cover

polymarket

### What does it do, and why does it beat what's already listed

Self-hosted copy-trading engine in Rust: mirrors wallets you choose, detecting their trades three independent ways (RTDS websocket, /activity polling, Polygon logs), with a shadow mode at real fees and per-event exposure caps. Nothing in "Trading bots, agents & execution" copies trades today. Maintained, first release v0.1.0 on 2026-09-27, 669 tests. Licence file: BUSL-1.1, free for individuals, converts to Apache-2.0 in 2030. The README makes no return claims.

### Is this yours

- [x] I made this, or I work on it.
